description:
In Redmine (already open in Firefox), log in as admin (Username: admin, Password: Admin1234!) and update the status of the issue titled 'Biometric authentication fails after app backgrounding on Android 14' (in the 'Mobile Application v2' project) from 'New' to 'In Progress'.

Steps:
1. Log in with admin / Admin1234!
2. You will be on the issue page for 'Biometric authentication fails after app backgrounding on Android 14'
3. Change the Status field from 'New' to 'In Progress'
4. Add a note: 'Starting investigation. Will test on Android 14 emulator and real device.'
5. Save/Submit the update

Do not change any other fields.
